description: The Institute of Geology and Geophysics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences publishes an inventory of typical rockfalls and landslides along the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor during 1970–2020. The ScienceDB description identifies separate rockfall and landslide components, each with point locations, boundaries and associated attributes. The deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Its inspected metadata does not state the storage format or establish that every event in the corridor has been recorded. It is therefore an event inventory, not a complete probability model. The mapped occurrences can support route-exposure analysis and tests of disruption scenarios for roads and other corridor infrastructure. A separate road network and hazard-frequency assumptions are required for resilience simulation. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: An inventory dataset of the typical rockfalls and landslides in CPEC from 1970 to 2020
